products.name: Bio-Vion
products.tagline: Crafted to Seal, Made to Heal

description.about:
Bio-Vion is Dentessa's next-generation injectable bioceramic root canal sealer, engineered to deliver a superior hermetic seal, excellent biocompatibility, and effortless clinical handling. Developed for the modern endodontist, Bio-Vion's single-component premixed formula eliminates the need for mixing and sets in the presence of moisture — working with the clinical environment rather than against it.

Compatible with cold and warm obturation techniques, Bio-Vion integrates seamlessly into single cone, lateral compaction, or thermoplasticised gutta percha workflows, giving clinicians the freedom to work in their preferred technique without compromise.
indications: Permanent obturation of root canals
Compatible with both cold and warm obturation techniques
Suitable for use with single cone, lateral compaction, or thermoplasticised gutta percha techniques

key_benefits.detail: Promotes hard tissue formation, supporting natural periapical healing.
Excellent sealing ability — adapts to canal anatomy and fills accessory canals.
Clearly visible on X-rays for accurate clinical assessment post-obturation.
Ready-to-use — no mixing, no waste, consistent dose every time.
Sets in the presence of moisture, eliminating sensitivity to a wet canal environment.
Antimicrobial alkaline environment inhibits residual bacterial activity.
Dimensionally stable on setting — no shrinkage, no microleakage gaps.
